answer_4.quote: Three well-educated annotators are hired to evaluate the quality of generation, where the evaluation is conducted in a double-blind fashion.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated copywriting on four aspects: readability, informativeness, attractiveness, and rationality, scoring from 1 (bad) to 4 (good).
